name: Free Meals
description: Hot meals you can get for free, no questions asked.

name: First Aid
description: Bandages and basic care for cuts, blisters, scrapes, sore feet, and small injuries.

name: Hygiene & Toiletries
description: Free soap, toothbrushes, deodorant, razors, wipes, and other personal care items.

name: Harm Reduction
description: Narcan, clean needles, test strips, and safer-use supplies, with no judgment.

name: Menstrual Care
description: Free pads, tampons, and other period supplies.

name: Food Pantries
description: Free groceries and food boxes to take home, cook, or keep for later.

name: Medical Care
description: Doctors, nurses, and clinics for when you are sick or hurt, even without insurance.

name: SUD Treatment
description: Detox, rehab, and treatment programs to help you stop or cut back on drugs or alcohol.

name: Drinking Water
description: Free clean drinking water and places to fill up your water bottle.

name: SNAP Enrollment
description: Help signing up for SNAP (food stamps or EBT card) to buy groceries.

name: Dental Care
description: Free or low-cost dentists for tooth pain, cleanings, pulled teeth, and dentures.

name: Vision & Glasses
description: Eye exams and free or cheap glasses, reading glasses, or contacts.

name: STI Testing
description: Free, private testing and treatment for HIV, hepatitis C, and sexually transmitted infections.

name: Medical Equipment
description: Wheelchairs, walkers, canes, crutches, CPAP, oxygen, and other medical gear.

name: Medication-Assisted Treatment (MAT)
description: Suboxone, methadone, and other medicine that eases withdrawal and helps you stay off opioids.

name: Advocacy
description: Someone on your side who speaks up for you when you are treated unfairly by a system.

name: Medicaid Enrollment
description: Help signing up for Medicaid (Health First Colorado) so doctor visits and medicine are free.

name: Outreach Social Events
description: Friendly outreach gatherings with food, supplies, and caring people, like Days in the Park.

name: Free Community Activities
description: Free fun things to do around town, like concerts, movies, art, sports, and events.

name: Drop-In Spaces
description: Indoor places to rest, warm up, cool down, and get coffee during the day, no appointment needed.

name: Youth Resources
description: Help for young people, about ages 12 to 24, including runaways, foster youth, and homeless youth.

name: LGBTQIA+ Resources
description: Safe, affirming support for gay, lesbian, bi, trans, queer, and nonbinary people.

name: Tribal & Indigenous Resources
description: Services for Native American, American Indian, and Indigenous people and tribal members.

name: Veteran Resources
description: Help for military veterans, including VA health care, benefits, and veteran housing.

name: Elder & Senior Resources
description: Help for older adults, about age 60 and up, like senior centers, meals, and aging services.

name: Community Centers
description: Neighborhood centers with programs, classes, showers, computers, and friendly people.

name: Support & Peer Groups
description: Groups where people with shared experiences support each other, like AA, NA, or grief groups.

name: Emergency Financial Assistance
description: One-time money help in an emergency, like rent, utility bills, deposits, or fees.

name: Benefits Enrollment
description: Help applying for government benefits like SSI, SSDI, disability, TANF, and Social Security.

name: Employment
description: Help finding a regular job, filling out applications, and getting hired.

name: Banking & Financial Services
description: Help opening a bank account, cashing checks, and keeping your money safe.

name: Legal Assistance
description: Free lawyers and legal help with tickets, warrants, court dates, evictions, and other legal problems.

name: Long-Term Financial Planning
description: Learning to budget, save money, fix your credit, pay down debt, and plan ahead.

name: Trash Bags & Disposal
description: Free trash bags and places to throw away garbage and keep your camp clean.

name: Clothing & Gear
description: Free clothes, shoes, socks, coats, gloves, and backpacks.

name: Tents & Sleeping Bags
description: Tents, sleeping bags, blankets, tarps, and gear to sleep outside safer and warmer.

name: Showers
description: Places to take a free hot shower.

name: Bathrooms
description: Public restrooms and toilets you can use for free.

name: Laundry
description: Places to wash and dry your clothes for free or cheap.

name: Shelters
description: A safe bed indoors tonight, including emergency, overnight, and severe weather shelters.

name: Storage
description: Safe places to store your belongings, bags, and papers so they don't get lost or taken.

name: Free & Friendly Public Spaces
description: Free public places where you're welcome to sit, rest, stay warm or cool, and use wifi.

name: Safe Parking
description: Legal, safe places to park and sleep overnight in your car, van, or RV.

name: Transportation Assistance
description: Free bus passes, ride vouchers, and tickets to get where you need to go.

name: Bicycles
description: Free or low-cost bikes to help you get around.

name: Bike Repair
description: Help fixing your bike, like flat tires, brakes, chains, and wheels.

name: Bike Locks
description: Free or cheap locks to keep your bike from getting stolen.

name: Car Repair
description: Help fixing your car so you can keep driving, working, or sleeping in it.

name: Gas Money / Fuel Assistance
description: Help paying for gas for your car, or fuel for heating or cooking.

name: Housing
description: Help getting a place to live long-term, like apartments, vouchers, Coordinated Entry, and rapid rehousing.

name: Furniture
description: Free furniture and household items for when you move into a new place.

name: Outreach Workshops & Activities
description: Hands-on workshops and activities at outreach events, like art, writing, gardening, and skill shares.

name: Free Classes & Workshops
description: Free classes to learn new skills, like computers, English, cooking, money, or parenting.

name: Technology Access
description: Free computers, internet, Wi-Fi, printing, and help with email or online forms.

name: Device Charging
description: Places to charge your phone, laptop, wheelchair, or other devices.

name: Phone Access
description: Free phones, phone service, and places to make a call.

name: Education Enrollment Assistance
description: Help going back to school: GED, college, financial aid, and signing up for programs.

name: Identification & Documents
description: Help replacing your ID, birth certificate, Social Security card, and other important papers.

name: Transportation
description: Ways to get to work, school, or appointments, like bus routes, schedules, and rides.

name: Interview Readiness
description: Help getting ready for a job interview, like clothes, practice, a resume, and a haircut.

name: Short-Term Work / Day Labor
description: Same-day or short-term paid work, like day labor, temp jobs, and cash gigs.

name: Volunteer Opportunities
description: Ways to volunteer and give back, which can also build skills, references, and community service hours.

name: Vocational Programs
description: Job training programs that teach a trade or skill, like cooking, construction, driving, or forklift.

name: Career Development
description: Long-term help building a career, like coaching, better-paying jobs, promotions, and work goals.

name: MENTAL HEALTH CRISIS
description: Urgent help right now if you feel unsafe, want to hurt yourself, overdose, or someone is in danger.

name: Mental Health Support by Outreach
description: Outreach workers who come to you to talk, check in, and connect you to mental health help.

name: Mental & Behavioral Health Care
description: Counseling, therapy, psychiatry, and medication for mental health or substance use conditions.

name: Online Mental Health Resources
description: Free apps, websites, chats, and text lines for mental health support on your phone.

name: Ongoing Mental Health Care
description: Regular, long-term counseling, therapy, or psychiatric care with the same provider over time.

name: Faith-Based Outreach
description: Churches and faith groups that come out with meals, supplies, prayer, and kindness.

name: Spiritual & Faith Communities
description: Places of worship and faith communities to belong to, like churches, temples, mosques, and synagogues.

name: Spiritual Support
description: Someone to pray with or talk to about faith, grief, meaning, or hope, like a chaplain.

name: Pets
description: Food, vet care, supplies, and pet-friendly services for your dog, cat, or other animal.
